Nana Plaza, 3, 1 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110 — Google pin
13.7413718, 100.5533082. Place ID 0x30e29ee747d4c47b:0xcd4b1377d9138499, /m/043thy,
Plus Code PHR3+G8. 4.1★ (16,237 reviews). Hours 7 PM–2 AM daily. 13,142 photos.
Official site: nanaplazabkk.com (Nana Partners LTD, operated by Panthera Group, lease
taken over 2012). "The world's largest adult playground."

text_sections.h2: INTRO
text_sections.text:
Correction to the brief: Nana Plaza is THREE storeys, not four.
The official site states: "The Plaza now has 24 agogo bars and three stand-alone beer bars
spread across three floors". Google Maps confirms three levels (floor picker 1/2/3; wall
plaques read "FL. 2" / "FL. 3"; no 4th floor anywhere — the "7" on the map is the Majestic
Suites Hotel ~70 m north, NOT Nana Plaza). Bangkok After Dark calls Billboard "on the
rooftop" — that means the top (3rd) floor, not a separate rooftop level. A roof canopy was
erected over the entire site in 2018 (~18 million baht); Panthera installed lifts, escalators,
new flooring and safety upgrades (~10 million baht). Short-time hotels occupy part of the
upper levels.

text_sections.h2: INTRO
text_sections.text:
U-shaped, three-storey, open-air complex around a central courtyard, on Sukhumvit Soi 4,
about 300 m / 2–5 minutes from BTS Nana (Exit 2 in most guides; Spankys says Exit 3).
Ground-floor courtyard: central open-air Beer Garden / Beer Bar ringed by open-air beer bars
(8–10 on the ground floor), main entrance with security checkpoint / bag check, ATM, massage
shops. One continuous walkway loop per floor; no second arm. Stairs and escalators connect the
floors (Spankys: "Each floor has its own staircase — you can move between floors freely");
lifts were installed by Panthera. Filming inside is unwelcome — two video creators say so on
camera, and one lost his inside footage.

text_sections.h2: INTRO
text_sections.text:
Floor numbering warning: sources use two conventions — Thai-style 1F = ground,
2F = middle, 3F = top (Nightdiveer, the 2019 plans); others call the ground level "ground
floor" and the middle level "first/second floor" interchangeably. This file keeps the two
plan sets separate and does NOT collapse them into one list.

text_sections.text:
Build Nana Plaza, 3, 1 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, from the reference photos
in this file. Use this file as the single source of truth for layout, materials and signage.

THE BUILDING: THREE storeys, not four. U-shaped, three-storey, open-air complex around a
central courtyard, on Sukhumvit Soi 4 off Sukhumvit Rd, ~300 m from BTS Nana. Single opening
on the WEST side (the Soi 4 / street end). One continuous walkway loop per floor, no second
arm. Roof canopy over the entire site (erected 2018). Lifts, escalators and staircases connect
the floors; each floor has its own staircase. Short-time hotels occupy part of the upper
levels. Ground floor: central open-air Beer Garden / Beer Bar ringed by 8–10 open-air beer
bars, main entrance with security checkpoint / bag check, ATM, massage shops.

ENTRANCE (Soi 4 approach, Dec 2025 Street View): "NANA PLAZA" white 3D letters, pink dancer
silhouettes, "The Worlds Largest Adult Playground" banner, Safety Zone sign, PRO EXCHANGE
booth, Stumble Inn on the left, KICKOFF / BUNNY on the right. The arch is ~100 m down Soi 4
from the mouth — not visible from Sukhumvit Rd.

COURTYARD: red-brick ground-floor courtyard, beer-bar tables and crowds, open-air beer bars
around all sides, both upper-floor walkways visible above with bar fronts. Night: neon
everywhere, pink ceiling canopy over the walkways, Christmas tree in season, food carts,
pool table in the courtyard (2017 + 2025 photos).

FLOOR LAYOUTS — use Plan A (2019, unit-by-unit) as the base, with Plan B (2026) noted where
it differs. Do NOT invent a single "true" layout: the sources conflict, especially Rainbow
1–5, Angelwitch, Cascade, Geisha, Erotica and Billboard's side.
- Ground: far/north end Obsession, Rainbow 2; west side Twister BKK (large, "the biggest bar
  in Nana Plaza"); east side Sports Bus, London Calling, Playskool, Rainbow Bar, Witchcraft;
  front/south row New Lollipop, Salon, Morning Night, Stumble Inn, Big Dogs, Tiki Bar, K&S,
  Hillary 4; centre Beer Garden. 2026 map instead: Lollipop just left of the entrance, Rainbow
  2 / Rainbow 1 / Erotica / Blondie / Witchcraft on the east, Obsession at the back.
- Middle: far end Rainbow 5; west Casanova, DC-10, Sexy Night, Angelwitch, Spanky's; east
  Twister, Temptations, Diamonds Bangkok; front Chili, Rainbow 3, Straps, Balcony Bar, Mercury
  Ladyboy, Mandarin. 2026 map instead: Rainbow69, DC10, Sexy Night, Angelwitch, Spanky's west;
  Rainbow 4, Rainbow 5, Stockings, Random 2 east; Whiskey, Random, Straps, Red Dragon,
  Mandarin front.
- Top: far end Geisha; west Office, Enter, Billboard; east Butterflies, Hotel; front Erotica,
  Hotel, Salon, Hotel, Mandarin. 2026 map instead: Rainbow 3 + Billboard west (Billboard at
  the top of the left staircase), Geisha north / Butterflies south east, Tycoon Agogo at the
  mid-landing of the stairs.

BAR FRONTS (build fronts, NOT stages — see limits): neon signs, curtained/gated fronts
(Angelwitch, DC-10, Erotica), Billboard behind glass, Lollipop and Casanova open-front
counters, the SE pool-table bar interior (the only true bar interior photographed — pool
table, counter, no legible name). Named signs visible in the photos: Angelwitch ("It's
Showtime! Angelwitch Rock Dancers", red Chinese lanterns), Bangkok Bunnies ("BUNNY"),
Red Dragon, Witchcraft, Geisha, Lollipop, Casanova, Charades, Mandarin, Balcony Bar,
Obsession, Fairy Bar, Candy Land, Beauty Shop upstairs. Wall plaques read "FL. 2" and
"FL. 3". The Billboard dancer photo is the only stage image in the set — use it for the
Billboard interior only, and label it as such.

SURROUNDINGS: Sukhumvit Rd diagonal, JW Marriott at the Soi 4 corner, Novotel Bangkok
Sukhumvit 4, "Nana" BTS station marker, Soi 4 (Sukhumvit 4 Alley) running east from
Sukhumvit Rd to the plaza entrance.

inside the bars — no stage is visible in any panorama or photo in this set except the single
Billboard dancer image. Do not assign a bar to a floor on the basis of a Commons photo — the
